name: Shirakawa Miho
source:
Daughter of the president of company where the main character was once work in.
A tidy high-school girl with gracefulness of a princess.
While she become someone adored by everyone at the school, she doesn't aware of it.
A polite girl gifted with both beauty and intelligence, yet didn't confessed by the man she secretly in love.
